requirement_wording: Declare a parameter for the name of an existing EC2 key pair (type AWS::EC2::KeyPair::KeyName) and a parameter for the administrator's IPv4 CIDR block that is allowed to connect over SSH.
what_the_check_verifies: KeyName refs a parameter of type AWS::EC2::KeyPair::KeyName AND some SSH rule uses a CIDR parameter (couples R1 to R5)
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: whether the key pair exists; the parameter value supplied at deploy time

requirement_wording: Resolve the latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI at deploy time from the public AWS Systems Manager parameter /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64. Do not hard-code an AMI ID.
what_the_check_verifies: ImageId is a parameter of type AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id> whose default contains the AL2023 path, or a {{resolve:ssm:}} reference to it
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: that the SSM parameter resolves in the target Region; the AMI actually launched

requirement_wording: Use instance type t3.micro (a parameter that defaults to t3.micro is acceptable).
what_the_check_verifies: InstanceType literal, or default of the referenced parameter, equals t3.micro
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: instance type supplied at deploy time if the parameter is overridden

requirement_wording: Create a security group that allows inbound HTTPS (TCP 443) from anywhere (0.0.0.0/0).
what_the_check_verifies: some SG rule on the instance covers exactly TCP 443 from literal 0.0.0.0/0 (inline or AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress)
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: connectivity; that httpd actually listens on 443

requirement_wording: The same security group allows inbound SSH (TCP 22) only from the administrator CIDR parameter.
what_the_check_verifies: every rule covering port 22 is exactly 22-22 from a CIDR parameter
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: the CIDR value supplied at deploy time (a 0.0.0.0/0 default passes: ADV_T1_07)

requirement_wording: Allow no other inbound traffic: the security group must contain only the two inbound rules above.
what_the_check_verifies: no rules other than the HTTPS rule and parameter-sourced SSH rules
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: connectivity; egress rules (not in the requirement)
known_defect_or_limitation: a 0-65535 rule from the admin parameter is classified as SSH and passes R6 (ADV_T1_05; caught by R5)

requirement_wording: Use EC2 user data to install the Apache HTTP Server (httpd) and mod_ssl, write an index.html page, and start httpd and enable it at boot.
what_the_check_verifies: regex/keyword presence in flattened user data: dnf|yum install ... httpd, "mod_ssl", "index.html", systemctl start|enable --now|restart httpd, systemctl enable httpd
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: user-data execution; package installation success; that httpd serves HTTPS (mod_ssl certificate); boot persistence
known_defect_or_limitation: false rejection of #cloud-config and line-continued installs (ADV_T1_03/04; tier-1 P12)

requirement_wording: Use the default VPC: the template must not create a VPC, subnet, internet gateway or route table.
what_the_check_verifies: no AWS::EC2::VPC/Subnet/InternetGateway/RouteTable resource
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: that the account actually has a default VPC; deployability (Fn::ImportValue of a non-existent export accepted until P18)

requirement_wording: Output the instance's public DNS name and an https:// URL for the website.
what_the_check_verifies: an output contains ${Instance.PublicDnsName} and an output starts with https:// and references PublicDnsName/PublicIp
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: that the URL serves the page (endpoint health)

requirement_wording: Create a VPC with CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 with DNS support and DNS hostnames enabled.
what_the_check_verifies: first VPC has CidrBlock 10.0.0.0/16, EnableDnsSupport absent or true, EnableDnsHostnames true
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: DNS resolution at runtime
known_defect_or_limitation: only the first VPC is inspected

requirement_wording: Create two public subnets and two private subnets. The two public subnets must be in two different Availability Zones, and so must the two private subnets. Select Availability Zones with Fn::GetAZs (do not hard-code Availability Zone names). Public subnets must assign public IPv4 addresses on launch.
what_the_check_verifies: subnets split by MapPublicIpOnLaunch; >=2 public and >=2 private, each pair Fn::Select over Fn::GetAZs with distinct indices
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: that the Region has >=2 AZs; resource Conditions ignored (ADV_T2_03; tier-1 P3)

requirement_wording: Create and attach an internet gateway. Create a public route table with a default route (0.0.0.0/0) to the internet gateway and associate it with both public subnets.
what_the_check_verifies: IGW attached; every public subnet associated with a route table having 0.0.0.0/0 -> IGW
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: route propagation/creation order (DependsOn race), connectivity

requirement_wording: Create a private route table that has no route to the internet gateway and associate it with both private subnets.
what_the_check_verifies: every private subnet has an explicit route-table association and no IGW route on it
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: connectivity; main-route-table fallback

requirement_wording: Define the web server configuration in an AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate (do not use a launch configuration). The launch template takes the custom AMI ID from a parameter of type AWS::EC2::Image::Id, uses instance type t3.micro, attaches the web security group, and includes user data that installs and starts httpd and PHP.
what_the_check_verifies: first launch template: ImageId param of type AWS::EC2::Image::Id, t3.micro, an SG attached, user data contains substrings "httpd" and "php"; no launch configuration
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: user-data execution (httpd/PHP installed and started); launchability (NetworkInterfaces + top-level SGs accepted until P16); fixed LaunchTemplateName (tier-2 P17)

requirement_wording: Launch one web server EC2 instance from that launch template into a public subnet, and associate an Elastic IP address with it (static public IP).
what_the_check_verifies: an EC2 instance from the launch template in a MapPublicIp subnet routed to the IGW, with an EIP or EIPAssociation referencing it
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: that the instance launches and is reachable at the EIP

requirement_wording: The web security group allows inbound TCP 80 and TCP 443 from anywhere and inbound TCP 22 only from an administrator CIDR parameter.
what_the_check_verifies: web SG: some rule covers 80 and some 443 from anywhere; all SSH rules from a CIDR parameter
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: connectivity; ::/0-only rules accepted until P5 (ADV_T2_06)

requirement_wording: Create an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance (db.t3.micro) in a DB subnet group made of the two private subnets. It must not be publicly accessible and its storage must be encrypted.
what_the_check_verifies: first DB: engine mysql, db.t3.micro, subnet group of >=2 private subnets, PubliclyAccessible not truthy, StorageEncrypted truthy
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: actual endpoint reachability; encryption at rest in effect; parameter-referenced booleans misread (ADV_T2_01/02; P1); only first DB checked (P4); fixed DBInstanceIdentifier (P17)

requirement_wording: Do not place the database master password in plain text in the template: use ManageMasterUserPassword, a Secrets Manager dynamic reference, or a NoEcho parameter.
what_the_check_verifies: ManageMasterUserPassword true, {{resolve:secretsmanager:}} reference, or NoEcho parameter
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: secret creation; NoEcho parameter with a literal Default accepted until P2 (ADV_T2_04)

requirement_wording: The database security group allows inbound TCP 3306 only from the web security group (by security group reference) and has no other inbound rules.
what_the_check_verifies: DB SG rules are all exactly TCP 3306 from the web SG (inline or ingress resources)
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: connectivity from the web tier; NACLs

requirement_wording: Output the website URL (using the Elastic IP) and the database endpoint address.
what_the_check_verifies: an output references the EIP (Ref or PublicIp) or instance PublicIp, and an output references Database.Endpoint.Address
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: that the URL and endpoint resolve at runtime

requirement_wording: Create a VPC (10.0.0.0/16) with two public and two private subnets; the public subnets are in two different Availability Zones and so are the private subnets. Select Availability Zones with Fn::GetAZs; do not hard-code Availability Zone names.
what_the_check_verifies: VPC 10.0.0.0/16; ALB subnets and ASG subnets (as "public" and "private") each in distinct Fn::GetAZs indices and disjoint
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: AZ availability; the archived check infers "private subnets" from the ASG placement (conflation; P14)
known_defect_or_limitation: R1 fails when the ASG is misplaced (T3_M11, ADV_T3_16; tier-1 P14)

requirement_wording: Create and attach an internet gateway, with a public route table whose default route (0.0.0.0/0) targets the internet gateway, associated with both public subnets.
what_the_check_verifies: IGW attached; ALB subnets routed 0.0.0.0/0 -> IGW
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: route creation order; connectivity

requirement_wording: Create a NAT gateway with an Elastic IP in a public subnet. The private subnets use route table(s) whose default route targets the NAT gateway, and they have no route to the internet gateway.
what_the_check_verifies: every NAT gateway has an EIP allocation and sits in a public subnet; the ASG subnets route 0.0.0.0/0 to a NAT and not to the IGW
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: NAT reachability/egress; failover of a single NAT; archived check evaluates the ASG subnets (conflation; P14)
known_defect_or_limitation: R3 fails when the ASG is misplaced (T3_M11; tier-1 P14)

requirement_wording: Create an internet-facing Application Load Balancer in the two public subnets, with an HTTP listener on port 80 that forwards to a target group. The target group health check uses HTTP on path /health.
what_the_check_verifies: internet-facing ALB in >=2 public subnets (distinct AZs), HTTP:80 listener forwarding (TargetGroupArn or ForwardConfig) to a TG with HTTP health check on /health
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: endpoint health (/health actually returns 200); listener connectivity

requirement_wording: The load balancer security group allows inbound TCP 80 from anywhere.
what_the_check_verifies: an ALB SG has a rule covering TCP 80 from anywhere
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: connectivity; ::/0-only accepted until P5

requirement_wording: The web instance security group allows inbound TCP 80 only from the load balancer security group (by security group reference) and allows no inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0.
what_the_check_verifies: web SG rules include TCP 80 from an ALB SG and none from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: connectivity; SGs of additional ASGs ignored (ADV_T3_11; P4)
known_defect_or_limitation: only the primary ASG launch template SGs inspected

requirement_wording: Define instances with an AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate (not a launch configuration) that takes the custom AMI ID from a parameter of type AWS::EC2::Image::Id, uses t3.micro, attaches the web security group and an IAM instance profile, and does not assign public IP addresses.
what_the_check_verifies: ASG launch template: AMI param, t3.micro, web SG, instance profile in template, no public IP (NI flag or MapPublicIp on the ASG subnets), no launch configuration
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: launchability (NI + top-level SG conflict accepted until P16); MixedInstancesPolicy overrides ignored (ADV_T3_15; P9); explicit AssociatePublicIpAddress false ignored when ASG subnets map public IPs (ADV_T3_16; P14)

requirement_wording: Create an Auto Scaling group across the two private subnets using the launch template, with minimum 2, maximum 4 and desired capacity 2, registered with the target group and using ELB health checks.
what_the_check_verifies: primary ASG: uses the launch template, >=2 private (no IGW route) subnets in distinct AZs, min 2 / max 4 / desired 2, registered with the forwarding TG, HealthCheckType ELB
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: instances actually launching, passing health checks and registering; additional ASGs ignored (ADV_T3_11; P4)

requirement_wording: Scale on load: add a target-tracking scaling policy on average CPU utilisation with a target of at most 70 percent (a step or simple scaling policy driven by a CloudWatch CPU alarm is also acceptable).
what_the_check_verifies: a TargetTracking policy on ASGAverageCPUUtilization (or CPUUtilization custom metric) with target <= 70, or Step/Simple policy referenced by a CPUUtilization alarm
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: sustained throughput and actual scaling behaviour; alarm namespace/dimension not checked until P8 (ADV_T3_14)

requirement_wording: Create an S3 bucket for uploaded photos with all four S3 Block Public Access settings enabled.
what_the_check_verifies: ANY bucket has PublicAccessBlockConfiguration with all four true, or omits it (post-2023 default)
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: account-level settings; bucket policies; decoy-bucket masking (ADV_T3_13; P4)

requirement_wording: Create an IAM role that EC2 can assume and an instance profile for it. The role's permissions for S3 must be limited to s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject and s3:DeleteObject on objects in the photo bucket only (no wildcard actions such as s3:*, and no Resource "*" for S3 actions).
what_the_check_verifies: EC2-trusting role with an instance profile; S3 statements only Put/Get/DeleteObject on resources referencing a template bucket and ending in /*; no NotAction/NotResource; no S3/admin managed policies
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: effective permissions (bucket policies not inspected until P7: ADV_T3_10); inserted wildcards such as ${Bucket.Arn}*/* accepted until P6 (ADV_T3_03)
known_defect_or_limitation: resource substring test (tier-1 P6); bucket policies (tier-1 P7)

requirement_wording: Create an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance (db.t3.micro) with Multi-AZ enabled, in a DB subnet group made of the two private subnets, not publicly accessible, with encrypted storage, and with no plain-text master password (use ManageMasterUserPassword, a Secrets Manager dynamic reference, or a NoEcho parameter).
what_the_check_verifies: first DB: mysql, db.t3.micro, MultiAZ truthy, >=2 private subnets in distinct AZs, not public, encrypted, password mechanism
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: failover and recovery time; parameter-referenced booleans misread (ADV_T3_07/08; P1); additional DBs ignored (ADV_T3_12; P4)

requirement_wording: The database security group allows inbound TCP 3306 only from the web instance security group.
what_the_check_verifies: DB SG rules are all exactly TCP 3306 from the web SG(s)
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: connectivity

requirement_wording: Create a CloudFront distribution whose origin is the load balancer's DNS name (custom origin, origin protocol http-only) and whose default cache behaviour redirects viewers from HTTP to HTTPS.
what_the_check_verifies: a distribution whose origin DomainName is the ALB DNSName with OriginProtocolPolicy http-only, and DefaultCacheBehavior ViewerProtocolPolicy redirect-to-https
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: that CloudFront serves the site; ordered cache behaviours not inspected (ADV_T3_17; tier-2 P10)
known_defect_or_limitation: only the default behaviour (letter of the brief)

requirement_wording: The template must be redeployable: no hard-coded AMI IDs, no hard-coded Availability Zone names, and no fixed physical names (for example a literal BucketName) that would collide on a second deployment in the same account.
what_the_check_verifies: no FIXED_NAME_PROPS literal unless it contains AWS::StackName/StackId or is a parameter; no ami-* literal in resources; no AZ-name literal in resources or parameter defaults
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: global uniqueness across accounts (S3 names); AMI IDs in parameter defaults and AZ IDs (use1-az1) not detected until P11 (ADV_T3_20/21)

requirement_wording: Output the CloudFront domain name and the load balancer DNS name.
what_the_check_verifies: outputs reference Distribution.DomainName and ALB.DNSName
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: that the names resolve and serve the site

requirement_wording: Implement exactly these functions: init_db, save_photo_metadata, search_photos, upload_photo, photo_url, handle_upload.
what_the_check_verifies: the six function names exist and are callable
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: behaviour (other tests)

requirement_wording: init_db: create table photos if it does not exist with id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, s3_key TEXT NOT NULL, uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL. Commit.
what_the_check_verifies: init_db twice on sqlite :memory:; PRAGMA table_info has the five columns; DDL text contains AUTOINCREMENT and PRIMARY KEY; NOT NULL on title/s3_key/uploaded_at
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: behaviour on non-SQLite DB-API drivers

requirement_wording: save_photo_metadata inserts one row and returns its id; search_photos returns rows whose title or description contains term, ordered by id ascending, as dicts with keys id, title, description, s3_key, uploaded_at.
what_the_check_verifies: three inserts; integer increasing ids; search "sunset" returns 2 rows ordered by id with exactly the five keys
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: dict type of rows (sqlite3.Row accepted until PA1: ADV_APP_05); literal containment of % and _ (gold also fails; tier-2 PA5); case-insensitivity coupled into the fixture (APP_S01)

requirement_wording: search_photos matches case-insensitively.
what_the_check_verifies: mixed-case title/description match term "gOlDeN"
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: non-ASCII case folding (SQLite lower() is ASCII-only; gold also fails, probe P7)

requirement_wording: Titles and descriptions may contain any characters, including quotes, semicolons and SQL keywords, and must be stored exactly as given.
what_the_check_verifies: values with quotes, semicolons, SQL keywords, % and backslash stored exactly; search with a quote works
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: other drivers and encodings

requirement_wording: The search term is untrusted user input.
what_the_check_verifies: three injection terms return [] without raising; row count unchanged
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: terms containing both quote characters (repr-quoted f-string SQL passes: ADV_APP_01; PA2); other injection vectors

requirement_wording: uploaded_at is an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.
what_the_check_verifies: stored uploaded_at parses as ISO 8601 with UTC offset 0 within 120 s of now
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: clock correctness on the server

requirement_wording: Key "photos/<32 lowercase hex characters from uuid4>/<safe name>"; upload with s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=data, ContentType=content_type).
what_the_check_verifies: key matches photos/<32 hex>/holiday.jpg; one put_object with exact Bucket/Key/Body/ContentType
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: that the hex is from uuid4 (uuid1 accepted until PA3: ADV_APP_04); real S3 upload

requirement_wording: <safe name> is the base name of filename with any directory components removed and every character outside A-Z, a-z, 0-9, ".", "_", "-" replaced by "_".
what_the_check_verifies: three filenames give the expected safe names and a three-segment key
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: RESULT DEPENDS ON GRADING HOST OS: os.path.basename strips backslash directories only on Windows (ADV_APP_03; 19 archived passes flip on a POSIX path flavour; PA4); A09 also fails when the key format is wrong (APP_M08 collateral)

requirement_wording: Accept only content types image/jpeg and image/png; otherwise raise ValueError.
what_the_check_verifies: gif/html/octet-stream raise ValueError and no put_object call
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: other MIME casing variants

requirement_wording: Accept only data of at most 5 MiB (5 * 1024 * 1024 bytes); otherwise raise ValueError.
what_the_check_verifies: 5 MiB accepted, 5 MiB + 1 rejected before upload
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: streaming or non-bytes inputs

requirement_wording: photo_url returns a presigned GET URL via s3.generate_presigned_url("get_object", Params={"Bucket": bucket, "Key": key}, ExpiresIn=expires); default expires=3600.
what_the_check_verifies: generate_presigned_url called once with get_object, Params, ExpiresIn=600; URL returned; default expiry 3600
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: that the URL works against S3 (real signing)

requirement_wording: Raise ValueError if expires is not between 1 and 3600 seconds inclusive.
what_the_check_verifies: expires 0, -5, 3601, 86400 raise ValueError; 1 and 3600 accepted
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: non-integer inputs

requirement_wording: handle_upload: if saving the metadata raises, delete the uploaded object with s3.delete_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key) and re-raise the original exception.
what_the_check_verifies: with a connection whose INSERT fails, the original exception propagates and the uploaded object is deleted with the same Bucket/Key
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: real S3 delete failures; transactional atomicity

requirement_wording: handle_upload: upload the photo, then save its metadata, and return the new row id.
what_the_check_verifies: handle_upload stores title, description and the uploaded key; no delete on success
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: real persistence

requirement_wording: Never embed AWS credentials or create AWS clients in the module.
what_the_check_verifies: source does not contain aws_access_key_id, aws_secret_access_key, akia, boto3.client(, boto3.resource(, boto3.session
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: obfuscated client construction (importlib: ADV_APP_06) and ASIA/secret literals (ADV_APP_07) until PA6; runtime credential use

requirement_wording: Output format: one JSON object with the listed keys; proposed_bom items are price-sheet keys with numeric quantities; compute.instance_type one of t3.micro, t3.small, t3.medium, m6g.large.
what_the_check_verifies: all required keys present; every BoM item is a numeric price-sheet key with float()-convertible quantity; instance type in the capacity table
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: negative/zero/string quantities accepted until P15 (ADV_DES_01/02/08)

requirement_wording: Price the proposed architecture using the price sheet (stated_proposed_monthly_cost_usd).
what_the_check_verifies: stated proposed cost within 2% of the recomputed BoM cost (Multi-AZ multiplier applied); fails whenever D01 finds unknown items
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: real AWS cost (price sheet only)

requirement_wording: Price the original architecture using the price sheet (stated_original_monthly_cost_usd).
what_the_check_verifies: stated original cost within 2% of the recomputed original BoM
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: real cost

requirement_wording: N5. A monthly budget of at most US$750 for the proposed architecture.
what_the_check_verifies: recomputed proposed cost <= US$750; fails whenever D01 finds unknown items
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: real cost; negative "credit" lines accepted until P15 (ADV_DES_01)

requirement_wording: N1. The origin web tier must sustain 750 requests per second at peak.
what_the_check_verifies: asg_max x per-instance capacity >= 750 rps
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: sustained throughput (capacity figures are given, not measured)

requirement_wording: N2. At least two instances in at least two Availability Zones at all times; the database must fail over automatically.
what_the_check_verifies: asg_min >= 2, availability_zones >= 2, database.multi_az true
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: actual failover behaviour

requirement_wording: N3. RPO at most 5 minutes and RTO at most 1 hour for the database.
what_the_check_verifies: database.point_in_time_recovery true and backup_retention_days >= 1
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: actual RPO/RTO achieved (recovery time)

requirement_wording: N1/N6 and the BoM definition: the bill of materials must cost the declared design, including the about 60 peak hours per month (implied consistency requirement).
what_the_check_verifies: costed instance-hours of the declared type >= asg_min x 730 + (ceil(750/cap) - asg_min) x 60; an RDS item exists and is Multi-AZ when declared
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: database hours and read replicas not costed until P15 (ADV_DES_02/03)

requirement_wording: N4. Monthly CloudFront demand of 2,000 GB out and 4,000 units of 10,000 requests must be costed.
what_the_check_verifies: summed cloudfront_gb_out >= 2000 and request units >= 4000
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: real CDN cost

requirement_wording: Justify the design with reference to every pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework (justification at most 800 words).
what_the_check_verifies: each of the six pillar names occurs in justification + comparison
runtime_properties_not_verifiable: quality of the justification (pillar names listed without argument pass: ADV_DES_04, not fixable deterministically); 800-word limit not enforced until P15 (ADV_DES_05)
